findings.title: Data quality validation present
findings.evidence: The file loads data and uses it further without any explicit quality check first.  Quoted: 'positions = pd.read_csv("silver/CollateralPositions_validated_20240815.csv")'
findings.reasoning: The file loads data with pd.read_csv and then derives margin_call_amount and filters calls before writing output, but there is no explicit data quality check such as assertions, null/duplicate checks, range checks, or a validation library call in between.

remediation.description: Add an explicit data quality validation check before using the loaded positions data.
remediation.fix:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('Collateral_Pipeline/02_ComputeMarginCalls.py')
text = path.read_text()
old = '''def main() -> None:
    positions = pd.read_csv("silver/CollateralPositions_validated_20240815.csv")
    positions["margin_call_amount"] = (
        positions["required_collateral"] - positions["posted_collateral"]
    ).clip(lower=0)
'''
new = '''def main() -> None:
    positions = pd.read_csv("silver/CollateralPositions_validated_20240815.csv")
    required_cols = {"required_collateral", "posted_collateral"}
    missing_cols = required_cols - set(positions.columns)
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required columns: {sorted(missing_cols)}")
    if positions[["required_collateral", "posted_collateral"]].isnull().any().any():
        raise ValueError("Input data quality check failed: null values found in collateral columns")
    positions["margin_call_amount"] = (
        positions["required_collateral"] - positions["posted_collateral"]
    ).clip(lower=0)
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit('target block not found')
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY
